title: Mega Don in Sapporo
author: Sergiy Galyonkin
why: Exterior of MEGA Don Quijote Sapporo (Tanukikoji main store, Minami 3-jo Nishi 4) at dusk with the vertical MEGAドンキ sign and lit shopfront — exact store, evening. Shot in July (no snow, but almost no foliage in frame), so season-neutral-ish. Interior CC shots in the feed showed risqué product packaging and were rejected.
